Dear Madam/Sir, 
 
Sub: Recording of Earnings Call. 
 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find below the link of recording of 
Earnings Call for Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026

https://www.tanla.com/investor-relations/quarterly-results 
 
 
Request you to take the same on record and oblige. 
 
Thanking you 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Tanla Platforms Limited
